tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs/dpal 'chi med bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por slob ma snod du rung ba gcig gis/bdag 'chi med sa
༄༅/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs/dpal 'chi med bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por slob ma snod du rung ba gcig gis/bdag 'chi med sa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs/

dpal 'chi med bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dang por slob ma snod du rung ba gcig gis/ bdag 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag kun zhu zer na/ tsan+dan dmar po'i lde gu'am/ li khri'i btsag gis chos 'byung gru gsum gcig bya/ de la tshom bu gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis skor/ tshogs kyi yo byad bshams/ spros pa la dga' na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ bsdu na/ sum+bha ni mang du bzlas te bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ kho nas mchod gtor thams cad byin gyis rlabs/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar mngon rtogs bsgoms/ gtong bsngo bya/ slob dpon rang nyid rdzogs rim bsgoms/ bzlas pa yang cung zad bya/ 'grub na skabs 'dir yang tshogs 'khor gcig byed/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs gtor btang la bgegs phyir bskrad/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags bya/ sa gzhi la chang gis chos 'byung gru gsum gcig bris/ de'i steng du slob ma langs te sdod du 'jug / slob ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i skur lam ste bsgoms/ lte 'og tu chos 'byung gru gsum zur gsum pa la oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbus su sngags tshan gsum yi ge brtsegs ma/ de'i steng lte ba'i thad du hrīḥdamar ser sgom du bcug la/ chos 'byung de g.yon bskor du sgo re re 'khor/ lus sems bde bas gang ba la sems gtod du gzhug /rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te slob ma la thim pa ra slob dpon gyis bsam zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra yun ring la drag po'am/ je drag je zhan bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma drag tu bzlas/ gu gul bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu dang*/ sha chen gyi bdug pa bdug go /des ma phebs na spogs chog bya gsungs te 'on kyang deng sang 'di ltar bya/

gzhan khyed rang lus thang sha bcad de nywa bzhi sgrims mig gyen du bzlog /rlung sna nas phyir sang sang 'bud pa yang yang byed cing*/ dmigs pa 'di la sems gtod cig byas la/ de yang rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bla ma dang*/ rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor gsum dbyer ma mchis pa sku lus gar sogs log log bsgyur/ zhal nas gsungs dbyangs lhang lhang 'byon/ rang gi g.yas nas lha mo dpal gyi blo gros ma dang g.yon na nag po bir+wa pa/ gzhan dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mang po dang*/ zhabs bro brdung*/ phyag gar byed pa/ gsung rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs lhang lhang*/ khyed rang la byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshul du bzhugs snyam gyis la/ rol mo 'jam pos brda' dang sbyar te/ e ma hoḥ kyai/ bu khyod tshur shog tshur la shog /lus ngag thams cad sems nyid yin/ /e ma hoḥ sems las gzhan du lus ngag med/ /sems la skye dang 'jigs pa bral/ /e ma hoḥ khyod kyi lus la 'chi ba med/ /bu khyod 'chi med rang grol la/ /e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro da tshur byon/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal da tshur byon/ /rdo rje phag mo da tshur byon/ /rigs kyi bu 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol/ /ngag 'chi med thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung thob sogs/ /sems la ye shes 'char du gsol/ / sems 'chi med thob sogs/ spros bral rdo rje'i thugs thob sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ de bzhin du/ lha mo dpal gyi blo gros da tshur byon sogs gong bzhin thams cad sbyar/ nag po bi ru pak+ṣa da ltar byon la'ang gong bzhin sbyar/ nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i lha mo gsum so so rang rang gi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi hrīḥl thim/ de'i shugs kyis rang gi lus nam mkha' la yer gyi bteg /lha mo dpal gyis blo gros dang bir+wa pas kyang g.yas g.yon nas me tog ste mchod pa mang po sprin ltar gtibs/

sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te khyed rang steng gi nam mkha' mtha' med la ye re re 'gro bar bsam zhing mthar de'i ngang la mi dmigs par zhog cig byas la/ oṃ āḥhriḥhūṃ hūṃ hā/ zhes brjod pa dang bstun nas rol mo'i sgra/ dang po cung zad dal zhing*/ mthar je drag je drag btang ste yun ring du 'bud dkrol bya/ rol chen mi 'byor ba'i yul dang gang zag 'dzoms pa mi med lung stong du bya btang dpon slob 'dzoms pa lta bu yin na yang*/ ḍā dril lam/ tīng shag tsam mi dgos kha med yin no/ /'di skabs ye shes phebs na dngos grub myur du thob cing*/ byin rlabs dpag tu med gsungs/ ba spu ldang zhing skyi g.ya' ba dang*/ rnam rtog cung zad log cing*/ 'phar g.yo cung zad tsam byang na'ang byin rlabs che ba'o/ /yid dga' zhing dmigs pa gsal ba tsama'ang byin rlabs 'bring ngo*/ / rnam 'gyur gang yang ma byung na byin rlabs chung ngu'o/ / 'di dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i sku'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po byung*/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ bum dbang thob par bsam/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa'i āḥ gsang dbang*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gis sher dbang*/ lte ba'i hriḥyig gis dbang bzhi pa'o/ / de nas oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par byin/ swa bhā wa nas/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'i bar dmigs pa rnams mngon rtogs ltar phog /rlung bum can gcig 'dzin du bcug /dzi ta dkar ba'i 'khrul 'khor bsdus pa de bslab bo/ /rjes maṇ+ḍal phul ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ rjes chog gzhan mi dgos te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa byas nas slob dpon rang nyid kyi lus las bsdu'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /sngar kun la 'phyan pa'i lus 'chi med kyi dbang bka' yin gsungs pa sems 'chi med kyi dbang bka' dang 'dra se ba de la bka' 'ga' re rgyun du lag len la mdzad mod kyang de zang ma yin/

lus 'chi med grub pa'i dbang bka' dngos smra ma de 'di lags so/ / ༈ da ni 'khrid tshul nyams su len pa la man ngag bshad par bya ste/ de la sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ste/ zhag shas sgoms su gzhug /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyang babs kyi spyi dang 'dra ste/ he ru ka'i lugs su byed/ maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i yul gyi gtso bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa rje btsun rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor gsum gsal btab/ de'i sku'i mdun phyogs su grub thob nag po bir+wa pa/ dbu la rten 'brel gyi byin rlabs kyi cod paṇa sngon po gsol pa/ phyag g.yas pa ba men gyi rwa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa gsol ba/ g.yon pa pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa/ sku'i mdun du ka pā la mahā ba las gang ba bzhag cing*/ dbra tso re'i pags pa'i gdan dang 'doms dkris can lhag ma rgyan dang na bza' spangs shing*/ rnal 'byor ba hur bag chags pa gcig /sku'i g.yon gyi phyogs su rig ma thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas pa bsgoms/ gzhan mtha' skor du bla ma dkon mchog mchod yul thams cad kyis bskor ba/ maṇ+ḍal yang de la 'bul zhing bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs kyang*/ dbang bzhi len pa rnams ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor gsum dang nag po bir+wa pa'i sku las len pa ni khyad par yin/ gzhan thams cad 'dra pa'i khrid tshul spyi khyab kyi sngon 'gro chos la nges pa rnyed pa zhig gal che'o/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi skabs 'di skad ces bya ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang song ba'i rjes su/ gnas mchog bde chen pho brang du/ /bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams su/ /slob dpon nag po bir+wa la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul phreng ba can gyi nags khrod du/ /bla ma dur khrod nag po la gsol ba 'debs/

/gnas o ṭi bi sha'i dur khrod du/ /slob dpon bram ze nag po la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul gang ga'i byang phyogs nges med du/ /grub thob la thod mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas ri gong dpal gyi yang dgon du/ /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje grub brnyes mchog de'i gdan sa ru/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /de man chad nai gu chos drug gi brgyud 'debs bzhin byas pas chog /'chi med grub pa 'di la sngon lo ts+tsha ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gyur mi gcig pa 'ga' re snang zhing gdam ngag gi mtshan don rang yang 'chi med grub pa bdud rtsi grub pa/ 'jigs med grub pa sogs 'gyur mi gcig pa mang po byung 'dug cing*/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang*/ shā ri bu ṭa sogs kyis bsgyur bshad lag len mdzad gdab/ 'on kyang gzhan de dag skabs 'dir mi len gyi/ byin rlabs brgyud pa can gnyan ston chen po'i lugs 'di kho na rtsis su bzung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug mdun du bris sku'i/ tsan+dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal 'byor na bshams/ bris sku maṇ+ḍal med kyang nyams rtogs mi skye ba'i lugs ma yin/ dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bshams/ thod pa la sogs pa'i snod gang yang rung bar/ chang la dam rdzas ril bu sbyar ba'i/ mdor na nang mchod kyi rnam grangs gcig med du mi rung*/ de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ bla ma yi dam mdun du bsgoms te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs/ sh+lo ka gnyis dang*/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs/ rgyun bshags rnams bya rjes tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom mo/ /nang mchod sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/

snod a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang gi dbus su hrīḥzung gsum la g.yon bskor du oṃ aḥhūṃ/ gzhan oṃ gsum las dmar ri mo bkang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas byang sems khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud rnams tshur bsdus/ bdud rtsi dang 'dres shing yi ge rnams kyang 'od du zhu bar gyur/ sum+bha brjod cing nang mchod myang*/ gdan srung ba yin/ yang sum+bha brjod de gnas khang dag gdan dang sa phyogs la gtor/ gnas srung ba yin/ yang rang nyid la nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ oṃ swabha was sbyangs/ rang lus 'od kyi phung por gyur pa'i lte bar pad+ma dkar po dang*/ nyi ma la hrīḥyig dmar ser de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las/ skad cig chos 'byung gzhal med khang pad ma nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gtso bo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yon du rdo rje rab sngags ma ljang khu g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas su rdo rje rnam snang ma ser mo/ g.yas gri gug / g.yon thod pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ thams cad kyang gri gug thur du sdigs shing thod khrag steng du 'phyar pa/ spyan gsum/ skra grol gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi bzad cing drag tu bzhad la/ bde ba rgyas shing lhag par khros pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i zhabs 'og tu 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ 'khor gnyis la gdan gsum char gyi lte 'og sor bzhi'i 'og gsang ba'i gnas su/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum re re/ gtso mo la dbus su baṃ dang de'i rgyab tu/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha ṭa ki ni ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā yi ge brtsegs ma dang*/

g.yon gyi la/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūṃ phaṭa brtsegs ma'o/ /g.yas la oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūṃ phaṭa brtsegs ma'o/ /de ltar gsal ba nan du lan gnyis bsgom/ de nas gtso mo'i dbu skra phyed phyag g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas kyi gri gug gis mgul gyi rtsa ba nas bcad de/ dbu ni phyag g.yon par thod pa dang lhan cig bzung bar gyur/ des rtsa gsum chad pa na/ rtsa dbu ma nas byang chub kyi sems dang rang byung 'dren pa'i rgyun byung ste/ rang nyid kyi zhal du thim bzhin pa dang*/ rkyang ma nas dkar po'i rgyun dang*/ bzhi mnyam gyi dwangs ma byung ste/ rdo rje rab sngags ma'i zhal du 'jug bzhin pa dang*/ ro ma nas rak+ta dang gla rtsi'i rgyun 'dren pa ste/ rdo rje rnam snang ma'i zhal du 'bab bzhin par gyur/ rlung phyir yang yang bzung zhing yid tsam bsgom/ lte ba'i baṃ las 'od 'phros/ ro rkyang gi lam rgyud bcad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon du 'phros te mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyi sku la phog /de gnyis tshur spyan drangs te lha dang lha mo/ chos dang chos 'byung dbyer med du 'dres/ yig 'bru brtsegs pa'i sngags gnyis dbus kyi yig 'bru'i g.yas g.yon du zhugs slar de rang nyid dbu rang gnas su bzhag pas 'byar par 'gyur/ 'og rlung bskum zhing lte ba'i yig ge la sems gtad de/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ṭā ki ni ye oṃ badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes zla ba nyid gtso bor mdzad la/ sngags bsdus pa la mos na/ g.yas g.yon gyi sngags thog brtsegs gnyis dbus ma la thim par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nyid bzla'o/ /yang sa bon gyi yi ge hūṃ nyid yid bzlas su byed pa'ang lugs gcig go /yang 'jam rlung bzung ste lte ba'i hrīḥlas me 'bar dbu ma'i lam nas song*/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg /de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te hrīḥl thim par bsgom zhing*/

hrīḥhaṃ zhes bzlas pa yang lugs gcig go /spyir gnas skabs 'dir lha sku bsgom pa dang*/ yid bzlas gtso che zhing*/ ngag bzlas gtso chung ngo*/ /lha sku 'od gsal du bsdu ba sogs mi dgos/ nam phyed na sa gzhi dur khro chen por bsam ste/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni byin rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ 'bru gsum kho nas kyang tshig rgyas bsdus khyad par med gsungs te/ bde mchog yab yum gang yang rung ba'i lugs gcig dang bstun na legs/ pheṃ zhes rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gsum spyan drangs/ spros pa la dga' na/ sngags gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas 'bul te/ chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sprul pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ sogs/ zhes bstod cing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ spyi dang mthun par 'dod don gsol ba btab yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha= zhes rang la thim/ gal te gtor ma mi lcogs na/ kha zas bza' ba'i tshe phud cung zad bcad nas/ cho ga 'di bzhin byas pas chog /༈ gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ thog mar 'khrul 'khor mi bya ste/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang*/ rang rje btsun ma'i skur skad cig gis gsal 'debs pa yud tsam yang yang dran par bya/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas/ mig dang yid sna'i rtsa bar gtad/ rlung dal bus phyir 'bud pa la lag len bzhin du bslab/ zhag bdun sogs sbyangs/ de nas yang de bzhag ste rlung dal bus nang du 'then pa lag len bzhin du bslab/ de nas yang zhag bdun la sogs pa bya'o/ /de 'og rlung rang gnas su bcings/ yar mi 'then/ steng rlung ran par drangs te lte 'og tu mnan/ gzhil ba sogs mi byed/ mi bde ba byung na sang gis btang*/ mig sna rtser blta ba'i/ smin mtshams su blta ba gang bde zhig bya/ zla ba phyed tsam bsgom/ de nas gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mi bde ba skyes kyang cung zad bzung ba sogs nyin re bzhin cung zad re yun srings te bsgom pa zla ba phyed tsam bya/

de mtshams nas rang re bod yul lta bur nyi 'od la brten zhing*/ snga dro sug chus lus bkru/ phyi phred til dmar ram/ rab tu zhun gyis dbang byugs zhes bshad kyang mi rnyed pas/ 'bru mar gyi byug pa 'thems par bya/ yang re go bzlog kyang rung gsungs te zhag bdun sogs zhag shes bya/ yang dri chus lus bkrus pa dang*/ bku mnyes spel ba zhag shas bya/ yang thang phra mo dkar nag gang rigs kyi rtsa rtse tshang ma brdungs pa'i khu ba bcing ba la shing thal lam lci thal 'jam po btab pa de lus la byug cing mnyes nas slar chu gtsang gis bkru ba dang*/ bku mnyes spel ba yang zhag shas bya/ de dag gi skabs su rlung sbyor sngar gyi de kha ci rigs par 'bad/ rtsol ba ha cang drag pas bcur bcur mi bya'o/ /de nas dzi ta karma'i 'khrul 'khor byang bar bslab ste/ rlung sbyor snga ma'i steng nas nyi ma dang po la thun re bzhin tshar lnga lnga tsam bya ste/ thun gsum gyis chog /de nas nyin re bzhin thun re la tshar re bsnan te/ zla ba phyed tsam na nyin zhag gcig la dzi ta karma tshar drug cur 'gyur/ de nas zla phyed tsam slar lhag por mi spor bar/ de kha'i rgyun bskyangs/ de dag gi 'khrul 'khor mi byed pa skabs thams cad du/ lus gnad khrong nge pa'i ngang nas/ mi rtog pa gtso bor skyong pas/ zla ba gcig po de la ting 'dzin gyi shugs kyis mi skye mi srid/ sngar rlung gi sbyangs pa gsum la zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ rdzas kyi sbyangs pa la zla ba phyed/ dzi ta karma zla ba gcig la byas pas/ lus shin du sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyi nang gsang gsum rang gang 'os pa gcig gi phyag chen gyi lus gnad bcas rlung bum pa can sbyor ba bzhi ldan spyi dang 'dra bar bsgom/ sems rang babs su lhod de ba'i ngang nas rang babs su cher re blta/ thun mtshams su dzi ta karma yang ji ltar 'os par rdeg go /de ltar zla gcig tsam song ba na/ thun gyi mgor dzi ta karma lan gsum tsam re song ba'i rjes su/

phyi'i aṃ grol gyi lus gnad byas/ rting pa phyogs gcig gis 'og sgo gnyis kyi bar bsdam/ gcig gi steng nas mnan te cung zad sgur ba yin/ lag gnyis gcig gis rkang rtse dang gcig gis bol gong nas bzung ba yin/ rlung bshang sgo btsum ste 'og rlung lte bar drangs/ de la steng rlung kha sbyar te g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyis gtun rdung drag tu byed pa yin/ 'di rlung la bsnan pa yin/ de lta bu'i rlung sbyor nyer gcig tshun bsgoms pa'i rjes su aṃ grol phyi nang gsang gsum gang rung gi 'khrul 'khor nyung mtha' yang thun re re sum cu so drug re byed/ rab tu thun re re la brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /thun gyi mjug la sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po bskyangs/ de ltar zla phyed tsam bsgom/ de nas yang thun mgor dzi ta karma 'ga' zung dang*/ aṃ grol bdun tsam song ba'i rjes rlung kha sbyor bum can gyi ngang nas/ yar stod la 'then 'then pa'i rjes su shugs drags pa rgyu zhabs su drag tu brdabs te gang rung du mnan/ 'dis rlung bsad pa yin/ de 'dra lan nyer gcig las mi nyung bar song ba'i rjes su/ phyi nang gsang gsum gang rung gi be ta gcig thun re re bzhin sum cu so drug nas brgya rtsa'i bar sogs byed/ thun gyi mjug tu phyag chen bsgom/ de yang zla ba phyed do/ /yang thun gyi mgor dzi ta karma/ aṃ grol/ be ta rnams lnga lngar bdun bdun te sgom ste/ rlung bum can gyi ngang nas/ rlung thengs re'i phyed rjes ma'i cha la sleb pa na/ rked pa nyag bya ste dbus su sgril nas/ de mtshams steng du drag tu mnan/ 'phongs stegs nas 'bebs chung gcig bya rjes sna nas sang ste btang*/ 'di rlung 'ching ba'i thabs yin/ de 'dra ba'i rlung sbyor nyer gcig sogs song mtshams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi be ta gang 'os/ gcig sum cu so drug nas brgyad rtsa'i bar du byed pa dang*/ rjes phyag chen sngar dang 'dra/

de yang zla phyed do/ /de dag yang na phyi'i bzhi kho na sgom pa dang*/ yang na nang gi bzhi/ yang na gsang ba'i bzhi byas kyang chog /yang aṃ grol gcig be ta gcig ban+dha gcig phyag chen gcig mos su byas kyang chog /yang aṃ grol phyi zab/ bhan+dha nang zab/ be ta gsang ba zab/ phyag chen gsum la khyad med zer ba ltar byas kyang rung la/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pas 'khrul 'khor gsal byed nyi ma'i nang gi be ta kho na yang bsngags pa che bar mdzad pa'ang yod/ gang ltar na'ang rtsa ba'i rkang gi 'khrul 'khor thun re mos dang*/ nyi ma re mos su ma nges pa 'chol bar byas na phan yon chung bas 'khrugs cing*/ gang yin yang rung*/ thog mar gang brtsams pa de nyid nyams len gyi mthil du nyin re bzhin du drag tu mi 'gyur bar bya/ thun mtshams kyi 'khrul 'khor dang bogs 'don dang*/ gegs sel la nges pa med do/ /yang de rjes sngar gyi rnams ma chags par bya/ lhag po thun mgor dzi ta karma lan 'ga' bzung bar bya/ rkang pa gnyis mdun du brkyangs/ lag pa gnyis g.yas g.yon du btsugs te rlung kha sbyor cung zad bzung nas/ bshang sgor drag tu 'then/ hūṃ sgra drag po dang bcas pa'i stong 'dren gyi mthar/ ro stod ro smad drag tu gcus shing 'dar si li li drag tu sprug /'di rlung bshig pa yin/ de 'dra ba nyer gcig tsam song nas/ phyi'i aṃ grol gyi mthar thig le sgra gcan gyen du bzlog 'grems pa gnyis dang bcas pa der/ tshar bcu nas sum cu'i bar bya/ de rjes phyag chen gong bzhin/ de yang zla ba phyed do/ /'di thams cad thun gsum gyi dbang du byas so/ /de ltar zla ba drug gis lag khrid song nas/ thun gyi mgor dbu bcad ma'i bskyed rim sgom dgos te/ spros pa che na yongs rdzogs bsgom/ bsdu na/ shu n+ya ta nas/ yid bzlas kyi bar byed dgos pa la ngag bzlas med kyang chog /de rjes aṃ grol/ be ta bhan+dha rnams yun ring thung cha mnyam du bsgoms kyang chog mod kyi/

gtso cher sum cha'i rim pa mdzad pas rlung la bsnun pa'i rjes su/ aṃ grol rlung thengs nyi shu rtsa bdun song nas rlung bsad pa bsgoms te/ be ta rlung thengs dgu rlung 'ching ba byas nas/ ban+dha rlung thengs gsum/ thig le sgra gcan 'grems gnyis dang bcas te/ bsnun pas 'chings gsum po re re la'ang bar bar du tshar gsum 'jug pa'am/ kun gyi mjug tu lan dgu tsam byas kyang rung*/ de lhag yan bum can dang*/ phyag chen sbrags pa byed/ de rnams nges pa can yin/ thun mtshams su spro na/ yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor rnams tshar re byed pa'am/ dgong thun lta bu thun gcig gi mjug las 'khrul 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis cha tshang re byas pas kyang don 'grub ste/ spyir de dag la mtha' gcig tu nges pa med do/ /de yang 'jig rten bya byed la brten pa'i/ brel ba dang bsam mno mi byed cing*/ chos la brten pa'i spros pa gzhan yang spangs te/ 'di nyid kyi nyams len rnams la rtsol ba che zhing*/ thun mtshams su bcur bcur ma yin pa'i bag yangs pa dang*/ rlung gi rnal 'byor la gnod pa'i zas dang spyod lam spangs/ kha zas ran pa thengs re bza' ba'am/ nyung ngu dus gnyis sam gsum brten kyang rung*/ mtshan mo gnyid tshims par log /dad pa mos gus nges 'byung snying rje sogs spyi dang 'dra yang*/ sems le lo'i rtog par 'gro bar mi byed par lhod de ba'i ngang nas rlung gi gnad ma 'chug cing brtson par byas na/ 'di'i bskyed rdzogs kho nas nyams rtogs skye myur la tshan che zhing*/ gegs med pa 'byung ba dang*/ drod kyi yon tan myur du skye zhing*/ drod thob nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ myur du phyag rgya chen po'i mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyas par slob dpon grub thob chen po u rgyan yul gyi bir+wa pa yi gzhung nyid las rtogs par 'gyur te/ chos gdams ngag gzhan la ma ltos par/ 'di kho nas rkang tshugs par 'dug

/ da lta'i lag len ltar na/ slob ma dbang bskur thob pa gcig la/ sngon 'gro'i khrid rnams rim gyis phog nas/ zla ba gcig gnyis nyams len byed du bcug de nas bskyed rim gyi skor legs par bslab nas/ thun gsum du nyams len byed du 'jug cing*/ lha sku la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ yid bzlas dwangs pa de dag ma mtha' yang zla re tsam sgom du gzhug khrid nyams su len pa'i yan lag tu bsnyen pa dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ spyir byin rlabs 'jug pa/ bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ nus pa rnyed pa dang*/ nyams rtogs myur ba'i gnad yod pa dang*/ de rjes bsnyen pa skyel du bcug na shin tu legs/ de nas gong du bshad pa ltar dngos gzhi rlung khrid la 'jug /dzi ta karma tshar re tsam thun gyi mgor byed pa de sngon ma nas kyang skyon med/ yan lag 'khrul 'khor rnams dngos gzhis 'khrid rdzogs pa'i rjes nas nyams len byas kyang chog /aṃ grol gyi khrid la 'jug pa nas thun gzhug thun mtshams ma byas kyang chog gang mos yin no/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdam ngag 'di la sngon gyi lo ts+tsha ba gzhan so so 'khrul 'khor brgya las med pas bsdus pa dang*/ yang lnga bcu pa dang*/ brgya nyi shu la sogs pa'i spros pa can yang byung 'dug la thod mgon po'i man ngag gnyan ston chen po'i lugs 'di la sngon gyi lo ts+tsha bas sum cu rtsa gnyis mdzad pa yin te/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin dang*/ shā ri bu dra'i gdam ngag las byung ba rnams kyang rnam 'gyur phra mo re tsam ma gtogs 'khrul 'khor so gnyis po 'di dang gcig par 'byung bas/ shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su nges pas/ lhag par khungs che ba de gnyan ston gyi lugs 'dir 'dug /'di la sngon chad 'khrid yig zhal gsal can yi ger 'khod pa mi 'dug pas lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor slob pa tsam las gzhan lam gyi dngos gzhi nyams len gyi rkang gtad la khad nub tu nye bar mthong nas/ sgrub brgyud 'di'i nyams len zhabs tog tu bsam nas/
